AboutPage.title: Our Story
AboutPage.paragraph1: Build Barguna Co-operative was founded by a group of passionate young individuals from Barguna who wanted to create a sustainable future for their community. Faced with a lack of local employment opportunities, they decided to unite and build a platform for skill development and self-employment through co-operative principles.
AboutPage.paragraph2: As a Primary, non-credit co-operative, our model is simple: we pool our members' skills and capital to create and invest in Joint Investment Projects (JIPs). We believe in the power of collaboration to foster economic growth and create lasting social impact right here in Barguna.

MembersPage.title: Become a Member
MembersPage.intro: Join a community of forward-thinking individuals dedicated to building a prosperous future for Barguna.
MembersPage.benefit1: Access to exclusive skills training and incubation programs.
MembersPage.benefit2: Opportunity to co-invest in member-only Joint Investment Projects (JIPs).
MembersPage.benefit3: Democratic participation (1 member, 1 vote) and a share in the co-operative's profits.
MembersPage.howItWorksDesc: As a member, you are a co-owner of the co-operative. You can propose ventures, vote on key decisions, and contribute to our collective growth. Membership requires the purchase of a nominal share and adherence to our code of conduct.

ProgramsPage.title: Our Programs
ProgramsPage.trainingDescription: We offer a wide range of courses designed to equip Barguna's youth with in-demand skills for the modern economy.
ProgramsPage.jipDescription: Members can pool their capital to invest in promising local ventures across various sectors, from agro-food to digital services.

BrandsPage.title: Our Brands
BrandsPage.subtitle: Discover the ventures and brands owned and operated by the members of Build Barguna Co-operative.

PartnersPage.title: Partner With Us
PartnersPage.subtitle: We are always looking for mentors, suppliers, venues, and institutional partners to collaborate with. If you are interested in supporting our mission, please get in touch.

GovernancePage.title: Governance
GovernancePage.boardDescription: Our board consists of elected members who guide the strategic direction of the co-operative and ensure accountability to all members.
GovernancePage.policiesDescription: Transparent policies and by-laws that govern our operations and ensure fair treatment of all members.
GovernancePage.transparencyDescription: Regular financial reports and audits to maintain trust and accountability with our members and community.
GovernancePage.meetingsDescription: Regular board meetings and annual general meetings where members can participate in democratic decision-making.

StoriesPage.title: Success Stories
StoriesPage.story1Description: How one member used our skills training to launch a successful digital marketing agency.
StoriesPage.story2Description: A joint investment project that created 20 local jobs and revitalized a neighborhood.
StoriesPage.story3Description: Young entrepreneurs building sustainable futures through co-operative principles.
StoriesPage.shareDescription: Have a success story to share? We'd love to hear how Build Barguna Co-operative has impacted your life or business.

Footer.description: Uniting Barguna's youth to create self-employment via skills training and member-pooled Joint Investment Projects.
Footer.legal1: Build Barguna Co-operative is a Primary, non-credit co-operative. We do not accept public deposits or provide microcredit. All venture investments are member-only and governed by approved by-laws and term sheets.
Footer.legal2: Domestic donations are voluntary, non-refundable, and create no financial return or membership rights. Foreign donations are not accepted by the Co-operative.
